# GramTap

> GramTap is a free, browser-based tool that turns an iPhone into a digital
> weighing scale using the WebKit 3D Touch force API in Safari.

## What it does
- Measures weight of physical objects placed on an iPhone screen
- Uses the `touchforcechange` event available in Safari on 3D Touch iPhones
- Supports grams, ounces, and kilograms
- Includes tare/zero function, force pressure bar, and stabilization detection
- Works as a PWA (installable, offline-capable)

## Compatibility
- Works on: iPhone 6S, iPhone 7, iPhone 8, iPhone X, iPhone XS
- Requires: Safari on iOS (not Chrome or Firefox)
- Does NOT work on: iPhone 11 or later (Haptic Touch, no force sensing)

## Accuracy
- Maximum measurable weight: ~385 grams (calibratable)
- Typical accuracy: ±5–10 grams
- Accuracy affected by: screen protectors, surface type

## Pricing
- Free. No account required. No app download.

## Developer Notes
- Built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Fully static export, hosted on Vercel
- Touch force API: `event.changedTouches[0].force / maximumPossibleForce`
